metadata.author: EduOS AI Architect
learning_outcomes: Understand the core concepts of Money
Connect the concept to real-world examples

ai_context.learning_goal: Ensure complete mastery of Money for a Class 1 student.
common_misconceptions: Students often confuse the basic definition.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use the real-world analogies provided in the hook and connection blocks.

blocks.title: Buying Toys!
blocks.body: How do we buy things from a shop? We use money!

blocks.question: What do we use in India to buy things?

blocks.back: Coins are metal, Notes are paper!

blocks.title: Rupees (₹)
blocks.body: Money comes in different values. We have ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10 coins. We also have notes for ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, and more!

blocks.question: If you have a ₹10 note and a ₹5 coin, how much do you have?

blocks.title: Piggy Bank
blocks.body: Saving small coins in a piggy bank can add up to a lot of money!

blocks.title: Paying Exactly
blocks.body: If a toy costs ₹15, you can give the shopkeeper a ₹10 note and a ₹5 coin.

blocks.question: A pen costs ₹10. You give a ₹20 note. How much change will you get back?
